stories.title: Amid the Iran war, the U.S. has pivoted it's geopolitical attention away from Asia
stories.description: A decade ago, the U.S. was still in its "pivot to Asia." Today, as conflicts in the Middle East suck up American military resources, analysts say that pivot is over — or never really began.

stories.title: Why does the U.S. military seem stymied in the war with Iran?
stories.description: Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn says while the U.S. military is facing long-range missile shortages, prolonged deployments and vacated regional bases, Iran is building cheaper weapons quickly.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
